settings.content: Controls ALL fonts across the entire store. One change here updates every heading, button, nav, and body text automatically.

settings.label: Heading font
settings.info: Used for all H1–H5 headings. Default: Poppins.

settings.label: Body font
settings.info: Used for body copy, labels, captions. Default: Poppins.

settings.label: Navigation font
settings.info: Controls header nav links.

settings.label: Custom navigation font
settings.info: Only used when Navigation font is set to Custom.

settings.label: Custom product title font
settings.info: Only used when Product title font is set to Custom.

settings.label: Navigation letter spacing
settings.info: Slight letter spacing on nav gives a premium luxury feel.

settings.content: Controls the core brand palette. One change here updates every button, icon, link, and highlight across the entire storefront. Individual sections can override these under their own settings.

settings.label: Primary accent color
settings.info: Luxury Gold. Used for buttons, links, icons, active nav, and highlights.

settings.label: Accent hover / dark shade
settings.info: Shown on button hover and active states.

settings.label: Secondary accent
settings.info: Lighter gold for decorative accents and hover effects.

settings.label: Page background
settings.info: Warm Luxury Ivory. Applied to all pages: home, collection, product, cart, account.

settings.label: Alternate section background
settings.info: Soft Cream. Used to create visual rhythm between alternating sections.

settings.label: Card / drawer background
settings.info: Pure white. Used for product cards, blog cards, modals, drawers, and forms.

settings.label: Heading / primary text
settings.info: Luxury Charcoal. Used for all headings.

settings.label: Secondary text
settings.info: Captions, labels, descriptions.

settings.label: Light / placeholder text
settings.info: Placeholders, disabled states.

settings.label: Divider / hairline color
settings.info: Used for thin horizontal lines between sections and content areas.

settings.label: Footer background
settings.info: Matches Luxury Cream page background.

settings.label: Footer text
settings.info: Readable charcoal on cream.

settings.label: Star rating color
settings.info: Gold stars for product reviews.

settings.label: Max container width
settings.info: Maximum width of all page content areas.

settings.label: Max content width (inner)
settings.info: Tighter max-width for article/text-heavy content.

settings.label: Section vertical padding (desktop)
settings.info: Scales down automatically on tablet (80px) and mobile (56px).

settings.label: Grid gap
settings.info: Default spacing between grid items (cards, columns, etc.).

settings.content: Controls border radius for all elements. These values update every button, card, input, badge, drawer, and popup simultaneously.

settings.label: Button radius
settings.info: 0 = sharp corners. 10 = luxury soft. 100 = pill.

settings.label: Card radius
settings.info: Applied to product cards, blog cards, and content panels.

settings.label: Input / field radius
settings.info: Applied to all text inputs, select fields, and search bars.

settings.label: Badge radius
settings.info: Sale, New, and bestseller badge corner radius.

settings.label: Image corner radius
settings.info: Applied to product images, blog thumbnails, and media.

settings.label: Drawer / sidebar radius
settings.info: Cart drawer, filter sidebar, mobile menu panel.

settings.label: Popup / modal radius
settings.info: Quick view, cookie popup, announcement popup.

settings.content: CSS box-shadow values. Keep them warm and subtle for a luxury feel. Example: '0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.08)'

settings.label: Enable scroll reveal animations
settings.info: Disable for faster perceived performance or for accessibility. Always off for users who prefer reduced motion.

settings.content: Controls ALL buttons across the entire store. Individual sections may further override button colors via their own Section Colors settings.

settings.label: Product image ratio
settings.info: Upload product images at the matching ratio for best results. Recommended: 800 × 1000px.

settings.label: Show secondary image on hover
settings.info: Requires a second product image. Shows alternate angle on card hover.

settings.content: Global responsive type scale. Uses clamp() — no per-breakpoint pixel values needed. Existing font family settings above are preserved.

settings.label: Global type scale
settings.info: Scales all typography proportionally.

settings.content: Recommended uploads: Product 2000×2000 (1:1). Collection/Category 1200×1500 (4:5). Hero 1920×900 desktop, 1400×1000 tablet, 900×1200 mobile. Before/after 1200×1500. Blog 1200×800. Testimonial & ingredient 800–1000px square. See docs/IMAGE-SYSTEM.md.
Configure UK and US details for contact pages and support messaging. Uses Shopify Markets country selection — prices and currency follow your market setup automatically.

settings.label: Support response time
settings.default: We reply within one business day.

settings.label: Shipping message (UK)
settings.default: Free UK delivery on qualifying orders

settings.label: Shipping message (US)
settings.default: Free US shipping on qualifying orders

settings.label: Company registration line
settings.info: Shown on contact page when enabled in the section.

settings.content: Premium styling for the Dawn AJAX cart drawer (theme layout). Works with UC Premium Header when AJAX cart drawer is enabled.

settings.label: Empty cart description
settings.default: Discover salon-grade hair color and care made for you.

settings.label: Free shipping threshold (store currency)
settings.info: Whole amount, e.g. 50 for £50 / $50

settings.label: Progress message
settings.default: Spend [amount] more to unlock free shipping

settings.content: Checkout CSS cannot ship in the theme ZIP. Paste the CSS from CHECKOUT_SETUP.md into Admin → Settings → Checkout → Customize → Branding → Custom CSS (1500 char limit). Set Poppins in Branding fonts. Cart uses the AJAX drawer when Cart type = Drawer.

settings.label: Show 404 error finder panel
settings.info: On the 404 page only: shows a diagnostic panel. Leave OFF for customers; turn ON while debugging.

settings.content: If the store homepage shows Page not found, re-upload templates/index.json and sections/uc-editorial-hero.liquid. Run node _diagnose_theme.js locally before uploading.
